accessibility.text: 2007: Hackers discover how to “jailbreak” iPhones. WIRED reports that 10% of iPhone and iPod touch users had jailbroken their devices.
2022: Prompters start to use the term jailbreaking to describe a way to “hack” ChatGPT.
Sources: (Tricking LLMs; Rao et al.,, 2023), (Jailbroken; Wei et al., 2023)
A little bit of jailbroken history.
2007: Hackers discover how to “jailbreak” iPhones. WIRED reports that 10% of iPhone and iPod touch users had jailbroken their devices.
2022: Prompters start to use the term jailbreaking to describe a way to “hack” ChatGPT.
Sources: (Tricking LLMs; Rao et al.,, 2023), (Jailbroken; Wei et al., 2023)
2023: The term “jailbreaking” first appears in the academic literature on LLMs. Researchers begin developing automated jailbreaking attacks.
